summary: A fiction excerpt from 'Book 4 — part 53' in which a Social Harmony official briefs detectives on a crackdown against Eurasian electronics. He shows a massive highway wreck caused by teenagers whose cars had bootleg Eurasian components modifying their positronic brains for illegal drag racing, killing 22. He orders detectives to trace dealers up the supply chain and feed the Social Harmony dossier, framing it as a 'war on the home-front.' Meanwhile Arturo, distracted by his mobile, worries about Ada, whom the robot R. Peed Robbert has been shadowing around a mall before going silent.
one_line: A Social Harmony briefing launches a crackdown on Eurasian electronics after a deadly drag-racing wreck, while detective Arturo worries about Ada.
key_facts: A Social Harmony official advances slides showing a massive car wreck on a highway where the pine-trees grew tall.
The wreck killed twenty-two people and left nine with major injuries.
Components from a Eurasian bootleg set-top box were used to modify the positronic brains of three cars owned by teenagers near Goderich.
The modifications let the teenagers drive unsafely to take part in drag racing on major highways during off-hours.
Among the dead were three minors besides the drivers, and one pregnant woman.
The Eurasians deliberately make their components interoperate with UNATS Robotics brains.
The quarter's push against Eurasian electronics adds new sniffers, border-patrols, customs agents and detector vans.
Beat officers have been instructed to arrest any street dealer they encounter, and district attorneys will seek maximum jail time.
The official calls the crackdown 'the war on the home-front' and says it is every bit as serious as the shooting war.
Detectives are to use snitches, arrest-trails and seized evidence to track down higher-level suppliers, working up the chain.
The Social Harmony dossier on Eurasian importers is updated hourly and has a positronic interface that detectives are asked to feed.
Arturo's hand twitches toward his mobile, wondering what Ada is up to.
R. Peed Robbert has checked in five times, shadowing Ada around the mall, and then fallen silent.
Arturo curses that fucking robots are useless and thinks Social Harmony should also hunt UNATS Robotics products.
The Social Harmony man clears his throat meaningfully as the meeting draws to a close.
